sentences.text:
Heard Mr. H. Mohanty, learned counsel for the Petitioners, Mr. R.K. Mahapatra, learned Senior Panel Counsel for the Union of India-Opposite Parties 1 & 2 and Mr. S.K. Rout, learned Additional Standing Counsel for State-Opposite Parties 3 to 5.
2.

A counter affidavit has been filed by Opposite Parties 3 & 4 jointly, wherein it is specifically stated at paragraph 5 (Page No.6) that, Pii Electrolyte brand is a product in respect of which FSSAI license is still valid.

The relevant statement reads as follows:-
".. .. The Pii Electrolyte is a product for which license has been issued by FSSAI popularly known as energy drink.

In the said product the word ORS has not been mentioned and therefore the license granted by FSSAI is still valid and no order to recall the product has been issued by the Opp. Party No.1 as alleged in the writ petition.
Copy of the Pii Electrolyte Energy Drink in the liquid form is annexed herewith as Annexure-D/4."
Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Date: 24-Dec-2025 16:43:40 3.

It is further stated at paragraph 6 that, "... ... None of the products as described under Annexure-8 to the writ petition nor under Annexures-C/4 and D/4 respectively to this counter affidavit have been prohibited for sale in the pharma unit in terms of Annexure- 1 and 10 respectively to the writ petition.

Only sale of deceptively namely beverages have been prohibited which are also violative of the provisions of the Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954".

sentences.text: But it is submitted by the Petitioners that despite such clarification given by the Opposite Party No.3 and 4 in their counter affidavit, still the products of the Petitioners in brand name Pii Electrolyte are not allowed to be marketed by concerned Food Safety Officers at different places in the State of Odisha.

5. Accordingly, the Opposite Party No.4 is directed to consider issuance of necessary clarification after granting an opportunity of hearing to the Petitioners on any working day to be fixed by him within a period of seven days from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
An urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.

( B.P. Routray) Judge B.K.
